== Notes ==
* The cripple is applied even when reapplying the skill.
** However, the cripple duration is reduced to just 1 second if using both a [["Swift as the Wind"]] inscription and [[Rune of Restoration]]. By reactivating Illusion of Haste during this second, the cripple condition will effectively have no impact on your movement. Consider using a weapon of Enchanting simultaneously to maximize the skill's effect.
